task.description: Evolve candidate programs when the real evaluation (a wet-lab assay, a long simulation) is slow or costly: a learned proxy screens, the real evaluator admits.
closure_criteria: a promoted candidate passed real validation, not only the proxy score
every 10th promotion is re-scored on the held-out set and the proxy is recalibrated against it
near-duplicate proposals are dropped before they reach the proxy
improvement over the single-agent baseline holds in all 3 repeated runs

baseline.metric: fraction of the single-agent final improvement reached (real evaluation)
